title: Input-conditioned Givens Mirror views versus CondConv basis synthesis

prior_art.fact: CondConv synthesizes effective weights as an input-dependent linear combination of expert kernels; Dynamic Filter Networks generate filters from conditioning inputs.
prior_art.hypothesis_delta: A scalar input-conditioned Givens coordinate on one shared physical matrix may recover useful continuously varying functions at lower actual bytes/compute than finite basis mixing, while remaining competitive with channel FiLM.

hypothesis: On a teacher whose effective linear map varies by an input-conditioned Givens rotation, a learned scalar Mirror coordinate on one shared matrix will match the full dynamic teacher within 1.10x normalized query MSE, and improve actual payload or measured CPU latency over an equal-budget 4-basis CondConv model in at least 2/3 fresh worlds.
mirror_coordinate: One scalar angle predicted from the 2D conditioning slice and applied as four paired Givens rotations to output rows

task.teacher: For x=[u,v], u in R^2 and v in R^6, teacher output is R(theta(u)) W_world x + b_world. theta(u)=0.8*tanh(u0)+0.6*tanh(u1). R applies four fixed disjoint 2D Givens rotations, each with angle theta; W and b are fixed per world.
task.data: Independent standard-normal x. Separate train/dev/query samples; no query use for selection.

controls.mirror_givens: Shared learned 8x8 linear map and bias; two-layer tanh conditioner maps u to one scalar angle; apply the scalar to four disjoint output Givens planes.
controls.condconv4: Four learned 8x8 expert matrices and biases mixed by a two-layer input gate with softmax; ordinary coefficient mixture control.
controls.film8: One learned 8x8 map and bias followed by input-conditioned eight-channel affine FiLM generated by a two-layer conditioner.
controls.full_dynamic8: Two-layer hypernetwork maps u to the complete 8x8 matrix delta and bias delta; expensive full dynamic upper reference.
controls.static_linear: One learned 8x8 map and bias, no input-conditioned weight view.

training.development_selection: Checkpoint with lowest mean MSE over two development worlds; evaluate every 50 updates; patience 250 updates.
training.fresh_rule: Freeze hyperparameters and architecture from development only, then train/evaluate audit worlds from fresh data and model seeds.

metrics.storage: Save each complete model inference state in safetensors with paid schema metadata; compare file bytes, not parameter counts.

success_gate: Mirror audit MSE <=1.10x full_dynamic8 and <=1.10x CondConv4 in at least 2/3 audit worlds, and Pareto improve over CondConv4 in actual payload bytes or CPU batch-1 latency; all payload components included.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror misses quality gate in at least 2/3 valid audit worlds, or CondConv4 matches/betters quality and is no worse in both bytes and latency in all audit worlds. Invalid data/split or implementation is NOT ESTABLISHED.
boundaries: Synthetic linear dynamic-weight mechanism, not a convolution benchmark or Transformer result.
Teacher deliberately has Givens structure; report that alignment explicitly.
No language, scale, GPU kernel, or general dynamic-filter claim.
